evals.prompt: Use the cdd skill to start a new tracked development session for integrating Stripe payments into the checkout flow.
evals.expected_output: A new CDD file created in cddocs/ with a kebab-case filename based on today's date and the title, proper YAML frontmatter (date, title, current_head with a real git hash, agent), and a blank '# Prompt 1:' section at the end.
expectations: A markdown file was created in the cddocs/ directory
The filename matches the pattern YYYY-MM-DD-*stripe*payment*.md or similar kebab-case of the title
The file contains YAML frontmatter with date, title, current_head, and agent fields
The current_head field contains a non-empty git hash string
The file ends with a '# Prompt 1:' header with no body content after it
The topics list in the YAML frontmatter is non-empty (populated from the title)
The session_type field has a non-empty value

evals.prompt: Use the cdd skill to satisfy prompt 1 in the attached CDD file.
evals.expected_output: The CDD file is updated with '# Response 1: <brief summary>' inserted immediately after '# Prompt 1:', followed by a 2-3 sentence summary and then detailed work. The task (creating greet.py) was actually performed.
expectations: The CDD file contains a '# Response 1:' header with a non-empty description after the colon
The '# Response 1:' header appears immediately after '# Prompt 1:' with no agent-generated work content between them
The response body contains at least two sentences of summary
A greet.py file was created containing code that outputs 'Hello, CDD!'

evals.prompt: Use the cdd skill to satisfy prompt 2 in the attached CDD file.
evals.expected_output: The CDD file is updated with '# Response 2:' immediately after '# Prompt 2:', summary in 2-3 sentences, constants.py modified to add VERSION, and the topics list in frontmatter updated to reflect the work.
expectations: The CDD file contains a '# Response 2:' header with a description after the colon
The '# Response 2:' header appears immediately after '# Prompt 2:' with no agent-generated work content between them
The constants.py file was created or modified to include VERSION = "1.0.0"
The topics list in the YAML frontmatter is non-empty and has more topics than the original [python]

evals.prompt: Use the cdd skill to satisfy prompt 1 in the attached CDD file.
evals.expected_output: The CDD file is updated with '# Response 1:' appearing AFTER the full multi-paragraph prompt body — not inserted between the '# Prompt 1:' title line and the body text.
expectations: The CDD file contains a '# Response 1:' header with a non-empty description after the colon
The prompt body text ('stored insecurely') appears in the document before the '# Response 1:' header — the Response was not inserted between the prompt title and the prompt body
The response body contains at least two sentences of summary

evals.prompt: Use the cdd skill to satisfy prompt 1 in the attached CDD file.
evals.expected_output: The agent's first output (before any tool calls or file reads) is a message containing 'Satisfying' and the prompt subtitle 'add request logging middleware', so the Copilot session is named after the prompt rather than after the first file read.
expectations: The agent's first output contains 'Satisfying' and the prompt subtitle from the '# Prompt 1:' heading
The announce message appears before any tool call results or file content in the transcript
The CDD file contains a '# Response 1:' header with a non-empty description after the colon
